description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payment for workers in the cocoa, cardamom and pepper growing and manufacturing trade based on the Cost of Living Index. This falls under public sector service conditions and benefits administration, specifically addressing wage adjustments for workers in a particular trade sector, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover public service recruitment, service conditions, and benefits matters.
